title: Evening Flock — Give opposed ring flights different starting speeds
help: The same eighty places receive opposed tangent flights. One ring starts at half the other’s speed, or both take opposed half-speed flights. Starting replaces the sky and clears beat history. These are starting velocities, not promises that the rings keep circling.
rows: Half-speed left ring opposes full-speed right
Full-speed left ring opposes half-speed right
message: opposed ring starts retain eighty places and their exact tangent speeds
